h1: Find your breaking point before attackers do.
lede: Breakpoint is an AI pentester. It attacks your code, web apps, APIs and AI apps every day, like a real attacker. Every finding is proven and comes with a fix.

stat.label: Average cost of a single data breach to a company in 2026
stat.source: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report, 2026

problem.title: Code changes daily. Testing happens once a year.

items.p: A pentest is a test attack on your own systems. Between two of them, only real attackers are testing your new code.
Security scanners produce thousands of alerts. Nobody proves which ones an attacker can actually use, so engineers sort through noise.
Breaches where attackers used AI cost about $1M more than average (IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report, 2026).
Breakpoint probes your code, web apps, APIs and AI features the way a real attacker would.
A finding counts only when it has been reproduced, with the evidence attached. No guesswork.
Each proven finding comes with a fix that is ready for your team to review.
The same attack is run again after the fix. The finding is closed only when the attack fails.

features.title: One platform for everything you ship

items.p: Reviews your code repositories in depth, the way an expert reviewer reads them.
Tests live applications with logins and API specifications, inside the scope you set.
Tests your chatbots and AI agents for prompt injection (text that tricks an AI), data leaks and misuse of tools.
Each code change, or pull request, is reviewed for security before it reaches production.
Checks the npm, PyPI and Cargo packages and container images your software depends on.
Reports support your PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and DORA compliance work. They are evidence, not a certification.

fit.title: Built for teams that can’t afford to guess

control.title: Powerful by design. Bounded by default.

items.p: Breakpoint tests only the targets you approve, inside limits you set, with your written authorization. Every run keeps a record.
Fixes are proposed for review. Nothing is merged into your code without your team.
Breakpoint runs in your environment with the AI provider you choose, or air-gapped with no outside connection. Your code stays with you.

faq.a: Breakpoint is an AI pentester from Singularity. It attacks your code, web apps, APIs and AI apps every day, the way a real attacker would, proves each finding by reproducing it and delivers a fix your team can review.

Breakpoint is for teams that ship software often and must prove it is secure: banks and fintech, insurance and capital markets, SaaS and software companies, telecom, energy and utilities, the public sector and defense, and e-commerce and retail.

faq.q: How is Breakpoint different from scanners and annual pentests?
faq.a: A scanner raises suspicions and an annual pentest is a snapshot. Breakpoint attacks every day and counts a finding only when it has been reproduced. Keep the certified annual pentest where regulators require it; Breakpoint covers the time between tests.

faq.q: Can Breakpoint run on-premises or air-gapped?
faq.a: Yes. Breakpoint runs in your own environment with the AI provider you choose. It can also run fully air-gapped, meaning offline with no outbound connection. Your code, findings and evidence stay on your machines.

faq.q: How do people stay in control of Breakpoint?
faq.a: Breakpoint tests only the targets you approve in writing, inside limits you set. Fixes are proposed for review and nothing is merged without your team. Every test run keeps a record of what it did.

cta.h: See what an attacker would find
cta.p: Pick one application. We agree the scope in writing, attack it and show you the proven findings and fixes.
